newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures end mostly higher, off peaks.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures end mostly higher, off peaks.

text.p: April 17 - U.S. debt futures closed mostly higher, but edged off peaks on profit-taking. Fed's Meyer said the economy was growing quite strongly, well above trend. Meyer also said economy was running close to capacity, maybe above. K.C. Fed president Hoenig said nearly all sectors of the economy were growing solidly.
